I will keep this plot low-cost because my money is not enough to buy fertilizer for every field, and I first think about the maize plot. On this small piece I will use the seed I already know, and because it is intercropped I will put manure if I have enough from home. I do not use chemicals much here, and I wait for the rains, not irrigation. My wife and children and I will do most of the work ourselves, so I will not hire people.
